description.value: Canada's only seaside mineral springs resort, set on 29 acres of subtropical rainforest on Salt Spring Island. Guests stay in private oceanfront cabins and have exclusive access to therapeutic mineral waters drawn from a well 150 feet below the ocean floor. A guest testimonial mentions bikes available for use on the property, suggesting a bike-friendly atmosphere.

address.value: 1460 North Beach Rd, Salt Spring Island, BC V8K 1J4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a legitimate oceanfront cabin resort on Salt Spring Island with mineral springs. A guest testimonial mentions 'Bikes available for use,' indicating some bike awareness, but there is no explicit mention of secure overnight bike storage or staff bike procedures. No amenities relevant to the WWC checklist (laundry, Wi-Fi, breakfast, etc.) are described on the website. OSM lists the community as Chemainus, but the website and coordinates clearly place the resort on Salt Spring Island — a notable discrepancy. OSM has no phone or address, but the website provides both a phone number and email.
concerns: OSM lists community as Chemainus (Vancouver Island), but the website and coordinates (48.923, -123.554) clearly place this on Salt Spring Island
No street address available from OSM or website content
OSM has no phone; website provides (250) 537.4111 and toll-free 1.800.665.0039
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Neither required criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure) could be confirmed from the website. The resort is a legitimate accommodation on a popular cycling island, but cycling-specific services need verification before directory inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: Guest testimonial mentions 'Bikes available for use,' suggesting the resort may lend bikes to guests, but this does not confirm secure storage for guest-owned touring bikes. Email: info@mineralspringsresort.ca
